The [[Tree of Vitality]] is a [[Monk]] [[plant]] [[boss]] that appears in the [[Aurora Glade]] and [[The Wilds]] missions.

== Missions ==
* [[Maguuma Jungle]]
** {{NPC location|Aurora Glade}} (random spawn, see notes)
** {{NPC location|The Wilds}} (random spawn, see notes)

== Skills ==
* {{skill icon|Blessed Signet}}
* {{skill icon|Guardian}}
* {{skill icon|Orison of Healing}}
* {{skill icon|Protective Bond}}
* {{skill icon|Restore Life}}

== Items dropped ==
* [[Plant Fiber]]
* [[Tangled Seed]]

== Notes ==
* In the Aurora Glade mission, Tree of Vitality spawns randomly at one of four points. It shares those spawn points with [[Kezra Spindleweb]], [[Chott Stormsinger]], and [[Wydd Kindlerun]].
* In The Wilds mission, Tree of Vitality spawns randomly at one of four points. It shares those spawn points with [[Grook Plugalug]], [[Chott Stormsinger]], [[Wydd Kindlerun]] and [[Grech Trundle]]. As such, there is a 20% chance that this boss may not spawn.
